title: Instructors
description: The people who teach your workshops: their public profile and the private details used in contracts.
newDescription: Start with the required details. When you save, we email the instructor a link to set up their account.
editDescription: Changes to the public profile show on the site right away.

form.publicDescription: What visitors see. Persian is optional: when it’s empty, the Persian site shows the English text.
form.privateDescription: Only admins see these. They’re used for contracts and for signing in, never on the site.
form.aboutDescription: Optional, but a photo and a few warm sentences help people choose a workshop.
form.inviteDescription: When you save, we email the instructor a link to choose a password. The link works for 7 days.

fields.displayNameHint: The name shown on the site, for example “Elif Yılmaz”.
fields.teachingFieldHint: For example: ceramics, painting or candle making.
fields.officialNameHint: Exactly as on their ID card. It’s used in contracts.
fields.idNumberHint: Turkish ID, residence permit or passport number. It’s stored encrypted.
fields.idNumberKeep: Leave empty to keep the current one ({masked}).
fields.idNumberKeepPlain: Leave empty to keep the current one.
fields.mobileHint: With the country code, for example +90 532 123 45 67.
fields.emailHint: They sign in with this address and receive their contracts here.
fields.photoHint: A square photo works best. We crop and optimize it for you.
fields.bioHint: A few sentences about their work and style.
fields.teachingLanguagesHint: The languages they can teach a workshop in.
fields.websiteHint: A full link, or just @username for Instagram.
fields.inviteLocaleHint: The invitation email and the page it opens will be in this language.

table.name: Instructor
table.workshopsCount: {count, plural, =0 {None yet} one {# workshop} other {# workshops}}

empty.title: No instructors yet
empty.description: Add your first instructor, and we’ll send them an invitation by email.

detail.privateDescription: For admins and contracts only. Never shown on the site.
detail.inviteSent: Invited on {sent}. The link works until {expires}.
detail.inviteExpired: The invitation expired on {expires}. Send a new one when you’re ready.
detail.notInvited: No invitation waiting. Send one so they can set up their account.

reveal.note: Each time it’s shown, it’s recorded in the activity log.
reveal.unavailable: Can’t be read. Please enter it again on the edit page.

activation.title: Active status
activation.activeDescription: Active instructors can sign in and be chosen for new workshops.
activation.inactiveDescription: This instructor is inactive: they can’t sign in and aren’t offered for new workshops.
activation.deactivateDescription: They won’t be able to sign in, and they won’t be offered when you create a workshop. Their workshops and contracts stay as they are. You can activate them again at any time.
activation.activateDescription: They can sign in again and be chosen for new workshops.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: Their profile is removed for good. This can’t be undone.
delete.dangerDescription: Only instructors without any workshops or contracts can be deleted.
delete.inUse: They have workshops or contracts, so they can’t be deleted. You can deactivate them instead.

toast.created: Instructor added. We’ve emailed them their invitation.
toast.createdNoEmail: Instructor added, but we couldn’t send the invitation email. Use “Send invitation again” on their page.
toast.inviteCancelled: Changes saved. Because the email changed, the earlier invitation no longer works. Send a new one from this page.

errors.emailTaken: Another instructor already uses this email address.
errors.mobile: Please enter the number with its country code, like +90 532 123 45 67.
errors.idNumber: Please use 5 to 20 letters and numbers, without spaces.
errors.photo: This photo couldn’t be saved. Please upload it again.
errors.notFound: This instructor no longer exists. They may have just been deleted.
errors.inUse: This instructor has workshops or contracts, so they can’t be deleted. You can deactivate them instead.
errors.idUnreadable: We couldn’t read this ID number. Please enter it again on the edit page.
errors.inviteInactive: This instructor is inactive. Activate them first, then send the invitation.
errors.alreadySetUp: This instructor has already set a password, so they don’t need an invitation.
errors.inviteNotSent: We couldn’t send the invitation email. Please try again in a moment.
errors.approveInactive: This instructor is inactive. Activate them first, then approve.

approval.title: Signed up on their own: waiting for your approval
approval.description: Check the details below (official name, ID number, mobile). Until you approve, they can use their panel but can’t be chosen for a workshop.
approval.confirmDescription: They can then be chosen for workshops, and get a “you’re approved” email.
approval.approved: Approved. We’ve emailed them the good news.
approval.approvedNoEmail: Approved. The email couldn’t be sent, so please let them know yourself.
approval.waiting: {count, plural, one {# instructor signed up and is} other {# instructors signed up and are}} waiting for your approval.
